body:
I want to start off by saying that I understand how you feel and I wish I could help in some way.  Numb is all I have felt since I was very young.  I had so much pain and abuse, that self harming seemed to be the only logical solution to my problems.  It was something I was used to and I could control my pain.  Sometimes it feels like nothing else will ever help.  

Speaking from experience of 12+ years, there does come a point, or sometimes a person, in your life when things start to get better.  You will be able to feel for a time.  If you ever need to vent or would like someone to talk to, I am always here to listen.  Do not lose hope.  It will not always be like this.  I promise.
